requests.name: Project Gutenberg
requests.starterQuestion: How do genres, publication dates, and author cohorts shape public-domain literary corpora?
requests.qualityRisk: Public-domain availability is not the same as literary representativeness.

requests.name: Library of Congress Digital Collections
requests.starterQuestion: Which subjects, formats, and eras dominate digitized public collections?
requests.qualityRisk: Collection metadata reflects digitization and cataloging priorities.

requests.name: Smithsonian Open Access
requests.starterQuestion: What kinds of objects are most visible in open museum collection metadata?
requests.qualityRisk: Open access coverage may differ by Smithsonian unit and object type.

requests.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API
requests.starterQuestion: How do object dates, geographies, departments, and acquisition histories differ across the Met collection?
requests.qualityRisk: Collection API records vary in completeness and public-domain image availability.

requests.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access API
requests.starterQuestion: What acquisition, creation-date, and department patterns appear in open museum data?
requests.qualityRisk: One museum collection is analytically rich but institution-specific.

requests.name: Rijksmuseum API
requests.starterQuestion: How do object type, maker, and period patterns appear in a national museum API?
requests.qualityRisk: API key and terms should be reviewed before broad collection.

requests.name: HathiTrust Research Center
requests.starterQuestion: What can be measured from extracted features across historical books?
requests.qualityRisk: Access workflows and rights constraints require setup before public artifacts.

requests.name: Internet Archive Metadata API
requests.starterQuestion: How do editions, scans, and metadata clusters form around canonical texts?
requests.qualityRisk: Identifier-level metadata is rich but messy and uneven.

requests.name: Chronicling America
requests.starterQuestion: How did terms like democracy, empire, labor, race, or civilization move through newspapers over time?
requests.qualityRisk: OCR quality and newspaper coverage vary by place and period.

requests.name: Digital Public Library of America
requests.starterQuestion: Which institutions and collection types dominate aggregated cultural metadata?
requests.qualityRisk: Aggregator metadata mixes local schemas and rights statements.

requests.name: Wikidata
requests.starterQuestion: How are authors, artworks, institutions, languages, and movements connected in public linked data?
requests.qualityRisk: Wikidata reflects contributor attention and ontology gaps.

requests.name: Open Syllabus
requests.starterQuestion: Which works and authors appear in syllabi across institutions, fields, and time?
requests.qualityRisk: Public access and export terms need explicit review before automated collection.

requests.name: Knowledge Commons Works
requests.starterQuestion: What methods and topics appear in open humanities repository records?
requests.qualityRisk: Repository coverage is field- and community-specific.

requests.name: Zenodo Humanities Search
requests.starterQuestion: What kinds of humanities datasets are deposited in general-purpose repositories?
requests.qualityRisk: Search results mix papers, data, software, and teaching artifacts.

requests.name: Harvard Dataverse Humanities Search
requests.starterQuestion: Which humanities data deposits exist in Dataverse and how reusable are they?
requests.qualityRisk: Metadata quality and file-level accessibility vary by deposit.
